svg.title: Accommodation of the eye
svg.desc: An equivalent thin eye lens increases power from 50 to 54 diopters while maintaining an inverted image at a fixed retina 2 centimeters behind the lens. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Accommodation keeps the image on the retina
Equivalent thin eye lens; anatomical shape and object position are schematic. As object distance
falls, power rises from 50 to 54 D at fixed di.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
